data.name: Cybersim: Noetic City
data.detailed_description:
A quiet home in a towering cyberpunk city.

Cybersim: Noetic City is a cozy apartment-decoration game with light progression elements set against a detailed futuristic cityscape. Settle into a high-rise apartment, earn credits through relaxed freelance work, and fill your space with furniture, lighting, plants, technology, pets, and personal touches.

There are no deadlines, fail states, or wrong ways to play. Work when you need something new, decorate whenever inspiration strikes, and build a home that feels entirely your own.

Design Your Cyberpunk Home

Transform an empty apartment into a cozy retreat, a sleek technological hideout, a plant-filled sanctuary, or anything in between.

Your apartment sits high above the streets of Noetic City, giving every room a distinctive cyberpunk backdrop while keeping the focus on interior design and creative expression.

See Your Space Your Way

Pan around your apartment and rotate the camera to see your creation from different angles. Hide walls or use cutaway views to reach every corner and fine-tune the smallest details.

The top-down presentation turns your apartment into a detailed diorama set within the architecture of Noetic City.

Life Beyond Your Apartment

Your apartment is part of a larger district building that serves as your home base. Travel to a selection of locations around the property and, as the game expands, acquire additional apartments within the building.

At Early Access launch, the surrounding city primarily serves as a visual setting rather than a fully simulated environment. The experience is centered on your apartment, its building, and the spaces available within the first district.

Key Features

Cozy cyberpunk setting: Create a comfortable home against the striking architecture of Noetic City.

Pressure-free progression: Earn credits at your own pace with no deadlines or fail states.

Permanent unlocks: Unlock each object once and place it as many times as you like.

Creative freedom: Build, rearrange, and rebuild without penalties.

Detailed diorama presentation: Pan and rotate the view, hide walls, and use cutaways to admire and refine your apartment.

A focused Early Access experience: Begin with one district, one primary apartment, and a growing collection of decorative items.

Functional Decor

Interactable options can be found across many items purchased from your computer. Apartment controls, TV channels, radio stations, lights and monitors. You have control to make your place one of a kind

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (DX12)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 5700 or GeForce RTX 2060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (DX12)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 6600 XT or GeForce RTX 3060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: NVMe SSD recommended
